description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'RolesHelper' for managing roles and permissions within the Apache Fineract integration tests. It includes methods for creating, updating, enabling, disabling, deleting roles, and assigning permissions via REST API interactions, along with some deprecated methods for direct JSON handling.

classes.name: RolesHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing roles and permissions in integration tests for Apache Fineract. Provides methods to create, retrieve, update, delete roles, and manage their permissions via REST API calls.

methods.name: updatePermissions
methods.description: Updates permissions using a PutPermissionsRequest object via the Fineract client.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PermissionData objects, optionally filtered by makerCheckerable flag.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role by sending a POST request with generated role data.

methods.name: getTestCreateRoleAsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON for creating a role with a unique name and description.

methods.name: getRoleDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific role by ID.

methods.name: disableRole
methods.description: Disables a role by sending a command request.

methods.name: enableRole
methods.description: Enables a role by sending a command request.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role by sending a command request.

methods.name: addPermissionsToRole
methods.description: Associates permissions with a role by sending a PUT request with permission mappings.

methods.name: getAddPermissionsToRoleJSON
methods.description: Creates JSON payload for adding permissions to a role.

methods.name: createRoleOperationURL
methods.description: Constructs URL for role operations such as enable or disable based on command.
